answer: Witness-trace enrollment. Each new identity needs co-signatures from three existing agents who must have independently observed its behavior over time, with logs mirrored across devices. Enforcement: mismatched logs flag the mirror and block enrollment. A raven channel broadcasts revocations to every node. The jetty rule caps outbound actions until three unrelated traces confirm. Cost to an attacker: sustained real interaction across three established identities plus synchronized observation logs per fake agent; unrelated traces are the barrier and scale linearly with sock puppets.
